LanguageData.ESCP_Skaal_Enlist_Letter_Label: The Skaal have taken the colony in as friends of the village. They have little coin, but they share their catch and their fire.
LanguageData.ESCP_Skaal_Enlist_Button_Desc: Live by the All-Maker's ways with the Skaal of Solstheim, who take only what the land gives.
LanguageData.ESCP_Skaal_Enlist_Requrements_Not_Satisf: The Skaal are wary of outsiders, and of you. Standing: {0}.
LanguageData.ESCP_Skaal_Enlisted_To_Hostile_Faction: The Skaal will not welcome those who have harmed them.
LanguageData.ESCP_Skaal_Missions_Desc: See what the shaman has asked for.
LanguageData.ESCP_Skaal_Menu_Missions_Desc: Tasks the village needs done. The Skaal pay what they can when it is finished.
LanguageData.ESCP_Skaal_Provisions_Desc: Smoked horker and fish from the village stores.
LanguageData.ESCP_Skaal_Storage_Desc: Leave goods in the longhouse. Nobody in the village will touch them.
LanguageData.ESCP_Skaal_Resign_Menu_Text: Leave the Skaal? They will not be angry, only disappointed.
LanguageData.ESCP_Skaal_Resign_Letter_Label: The colony has gone its own way. The Skaal wish you well, from a distance.
LanguageData.ESCP_Skaal_Kick_Out_Label_Title: The Skaal have decided the colony is no friend of the All-Maker.
LanguageData.ESCP_Skaal_Salary_Desc: A small share of what the village earns from passing ships.
LanguageData.ESCP_Skaal_Work_0_Desc: Track horker and wolves across the frozen shore with Skaal hunters.
LanguageData.ESCP_Skaal_Work_1_Label: Haul and trade at the docks
LanguageData.ESCP_Skaal_Work_1_Desc: Load furs onto the trade ships and take a share of the price.
